meta.name: docx
meta.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要处理Word文档，创建或编辑 .docx 文件
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle Word documents, create or edit .docx files

howto.what: Claude 可以按你的要求创建新 Word 文档（.docx），或编辑现有文档（如修改文字、替换图片），也能读取文档内容并转成纯文本。处理时支持目录、页眉、页码、表格等排版，还能管理修订和批注。
howto.when: 当你提到“Word文档”、“.docx”或要求生成报告、备忘录、信件等格式文档时触发。也适用于从.docx提取内容、查找替换、插入图片或处理修订/批注。

say.text: 帮我生成一份带目录和页眉的季度报告.docx。
say.note: Claude会创建格式规范的Word文档。

say.text: 把这个合同里的‘甲方’全部替换成‘乙方’。
say.note: Claude会编辑现有文档进行替换。

say.text: 读取这个.docx文件，总结主要内容。
say.note: Claude会输出文档的文字内容。

howto.what_en: Claude can create new Word documents (.docx) with formatting (TOC, headers, page numbers, tables), edit existing documents (text replacement, image insertion), and read document content into plain text. It supports tracked changes, comments, and various manipulations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'Word document', '.docx', or request a report, memo, letter, template as a .docx file. Also used for extracting content, find-and-replace, inserting images, or working with tracked changes/comments.

say_en.text: Generate a quarterly report.docx with table of contents and headers.
say_en.note: Claude creates a formatted Word document.

say_en.text: Replace all '甲方' with '乙方' in this contract.
Read this .docx file and summarize its content.
